eventMetadata.context_description: Trader sentiment for Kuala Lumpur’s August 6 peak temperature remains closely balanced between 33°C (45.5%) and 34°C (39%) because official Malaysian Meteorological Department guidance and ensemble models indicate a narrow range around the seasonal 32°C average high. Recent days have recorded 33–34°C peaks when clearer mornings allowed stronger heating before storms developed. Updated model runs tomorrow morning and METMalaysia’s 24-hour forecast will be the key variables that could shift the slight edge either way before resolution.
